description: A shell script for testing the behavior of 'git update-index' with symbolic links in the filesystem when core.symlinks is false. It sets up a test environment, manipulates a symbolic link, and verifies that the symbolic link property is preserved in the index.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test cases.
